findings.details: Root user MFA is not enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable MFA for the AWS account root user and protect the root credential.

findings.details: Console password is enabled but MFA is not active.
findings.remediation: Enable MFA or migrate human access to federation with temporary credentials.

findings.details: Active access key is 147 days old; threshold is 90 days.
findings.remediation: Rotate or replace the key, or migrate the workload to an IAM role with temporary credentials.

findings.details: No recorded console or access-key activity for 214 days; threshold is 90 days.
findings.remediation: Confirm the account is still required and remove or disable unused credentials following organizational policy.

findings.details: User has neither a console password nor an active access key.
findings.remediation: Confirm the user is still needed; remove unused identities through the approved access-management process.
